question_to_ask: Is DemoBank SG's undisclosed AI-governance gap a near-term capital risk, given MAS's incoming AI Risk Management Guidelines?
what_rating_sees: A stale 22.4 (Medium Risk) score as of 2023-09-30 — a calm, middling baseline that pre-dates and says nothing about AI governance.
what_we_see: AI-governance hiring is up +340% YoY while AI disclosure is 'none' — the bank is staffing hard for a risk it isn't disclosing. Governance momentum is +15%, yet positive news sentiment conflicts with a negative behaviour trend.
check_before_monday: For a risk mandate: pull the latest disclosures for ANY mention of AI governance, and ask IR why governance hiring is surging (+340% YoY) while disclosure stays at 'none' ahead of the MAS AI Risk Management Guidelines (finalising 2026, 12-month transition).
competes_summary: The rating calls this Medium Risk and stable; we disagree — an undisclosed AI-governance build-out running into a 2026 MAS deadline is an unpriced near-term risk the 2023 static score cannot see.
